title: rosa caesia subsp. bakeri
intro: Rosa caesia subsp. bakeri, commonly known as Himalayan rose or pink Himalayan rose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a shrub native to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Rosa caesia subsp. bakeri include reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and protecting against certain diseases.
